```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)

data_file <- "fmr2027.csv"

# fips and state have leading zeros
fmr <- read_csv(
  data_file,
  col_types = cols(fips = col_character(), state = col_character())
)

fmr <- fmr |>
  mutate(
    metro = factor(metro, labels = c("nonmetro", "metro")),
    # fips ending in 99999 is a whole county, otherwise a town
    record_type = if_else(str_ends(fips, "99999"), "county", "sub-county")
  )

# 2 bedroom rows only
fmr_2 <- filter(fmr, bedrooms == 2)

# one row per HUD area and bedroom size
areas <- fmr |>
  group_by(hud_area_code, hud_area_name, metro, bedrooms) |>
  summarise(
    fmr = first(fmr),
    pop = sum(pop2024),
    n_records = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
areas_2 <- filter(areas, bedrooms == 2)

# areas that cross state lines are kept once per state
state_areas <- fmr |>
  distinct(stusps, hud_area_code, metro, bedrooms, fmr)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig1
#| fig-height: 9
state_counts <- fmr_2 |>
  group_by(stusps) |>
  summarise(records = n(), `HUD areas` = n_distinct(hud_area_code)) |>
  pivot_longer(-stusps, names_to = "unit", values_to = "count") |>
  mutate(stusps = fct_reorder(stusps, count, .fun = max))

ggplot(state_counts, aes(count, stusps)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = stusps), color = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(color = unit)) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x = "count", y = "stusps", caption = "Figure 1") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig2
#| fig-height: 7
ggplot(areas, aes(fmr)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 100, boundary = 0) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(bedrooms), labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "count (HUD areas)", caption = "Figure 2") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig3
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(areas, aes(factor(bedrooms), fmr, fill = metro)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "bedrooms", y = "fmr ($)", caption = "Figure 3") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig4
#| fig-height: 5
# ratio to the 2 bedroom fmr of the same area
ratios <- areas |>
  group_by(hud_area_code) |>
  mutate(ratio = fmr / fmr[bedrooms == 2]) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(bedrooms != 2)

ggplot(ratios, aes(ratio)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, boundary = 0) +
  facet_wrap(~bedrooms, scales = "free_x", labeller = label_both) +
  labs(x = "fmr / fmr (2 bedrooms)", y = "count (HUD areas)",
       caption = "Figure 4") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig5
#| fig-height: 9
state_2 <- state_areas |>
  filter(bedrooms == 2) |>
  mutate(stusps = fct_reorder(stusps, fmr, .fun = median))

ggplot(state_2, aes(fmr, stusps)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(color = metro), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.25, seed = 1)
  ) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "point", shape = 124, size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "stusps", caption = "Figure 5") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig6
#| fig-height: 5
ggplot(areas_2, aes(pop, fmr, color = metro)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "pop2024", y = "fmr ($)",
       caption = "Figure 6") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig7
#| fig-height: 5
# add 1 so the pop2024 = 0 records survive the log
ggplot(fmr_2, aes(pop2024 + 1)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(record_type), labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "pop2024 + 1", y = "count (records)", caption = "Figure 7") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig8
#| fig-height: 4
# 2 bedroom fmr by record and by HUD area
units <- bind_rows(
  transmute(fmr_2, unit = "records", fmr),
  transmute(areas_2, unit = "HUD areas", fmr)
)

ggplot(units, aes(fmr, color = unit)) +
  geom_density() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "density", caption = "Figure 8") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig9
#| fig-height: 6
# 12 cheapest and 12 most expensive areas (2 bedrooms)
ranked <- arrange(areas_2, fmr)
extreme_codes <- c(head(ranked$hud_area_code, 12),
                   tail(ranked$hud_area_code, 12))

areas |>
  filter(hud_area_code %in% extreme_codes) |>
  mutate(
    hud_area_name = str_remove(hud_area_name, " HUD Metro FMR Area"),
    hud_area_name = fct_reorder(hud_area_name, fmr)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(fmr, hud_area_name, color = factor(bedrooms))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(2000),
                     labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "fmr ($)", y = "hud_area_name", color = "bedrooms",
       caption = "Figure 9") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig10
#| fig-height: 4
# areas with the most records
areas_2 |>
  slice_max(n_records, n = 15) |>
  mutate(hud_area_name = fct_reorder(hud_area_name, n_records)) |>
  ggplot(aes(n_records, hud_area_name)) +
  geom_point() +
  expand_limits(x = 0) +
  labs(x = "n_records", y = "hud_area_name", caption = "Figure 10") +
  theme_minimal(12)
```

## Data checks behind the figures

Checks on the data behind the figures. A record is one `fips`, an area is
one `hud_area_code`.

```{r}
#| label: check-size
cat("rows:", nrow(fmr), " columns:", ncol(fmr) - 1,
    "\nrecords (fips):", n_distinct(fmr$fips),
    "\nHUD areas:", n_distinct(fmr$hud_area_code),
    "\nstates / territories:", n_distinct(fmr$stusps),
    "\nbedroom sizes:", paste(sort(unique(fmr$bedrooms)), collapse = ", "),
    "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-missing
fmr |>
  select(-record_type) |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_missing") |>
  filter(n_missing > 0)

fmr_2 |>
  count(record_type, missing_town_name = is.na(county_town_name))
```

```{r}
#| label: check-duplicates
cat("fully duplicated rows:", sum(duplicated(fmr)),
    "\nduplicated fips + bedrooms:",
    sum(duplicated(fmr[c("fips", "bedrooms")])),
    "\nrecords without every bedroom size:",
    sum(count(fmr, fips)$n != n_distinct(fmr$bedrooms)),
    "\nrecords where fmr ever goes down as bedrooms go up:",
    fmr |>
      arrange(fips, bedrooms) |>
      group_by(fips) |>
      summarise(down = any(diff(fmr) < 0)) |>
      pull(down) |>
      sum(),
    "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-areas
# same fmr within an area?
fmr |>
  group_by(hud_area_code, bedrooms) |>
  summarise(n_fmr = n_distinct(fmr), .groups = "drop") |>
  count(n_fmr)

# records per area, areas in more than one state
areas_2 |>
  summarise(
    areas = n(),
    one_record = sum(n_records == 1),
    two_or_more = sum(n_records > 1),
    most_records = max(n_records)
  )
state_areas |>
  filter(bedrooms == 2) |>
  count(hud_area_code) |>
  summarise(areas_in_more_than_one_state = sum(n > 1))
```

```{r}
#| label: check-metro
# METRO codes should be metro = 1, NCNTY codes metro = 0
fmr_2 |>
  mutate(code_start = str_extract(hud_area_code, "^[A-Z]+")) |>
  count(metro, code_start)
```

```{r}
#| label: check-population
fmr_2 |>
  filter(pop2024 == 0) |>
  count(stusps, metro)

fmr_2 |>
  filter(pop2024 == 0) |>
  select(stusps, countyname, county_town_name) |>
  head(6)

fmr_2 |>
  count(stusps, record_type) |>
  filter(record_type == "sub-county")
```

```{r}
#| label: check-fmr
fmr |>
  group_by(bedrooms) |>
  summarise(min = min(fmr), median = median(fmr), mean = round(mean(fmr)),
            max = max(fmr))

# most common 2 bedroom fmr
areas_2 |>
  count(fmr, sort = TRUE) |>
  head(5)

areas_2 |>
  left_join(distinct(fmr, hud_area_code, stusps), by = "hud_area_code") |>
  filter(stusps %in% c("AS", "GU", "MP", "VI", "DC")) |>
  select(stusps, hud_area_name, fmr, pop)
```
